title: Keep on shopping - okay for a buffet table, but that's it!
text:
Keep on shopping - okay for a buffet table, but that's it!. This one has a ways to go before it is useful.
I bought it because our family loves deviled eggs and I make them almost weekly in the warmer weather.
I wanted a way to store more deviled eggs, as the container I had only held 12 halves. Not enough! The fact that each tray held 18 halves was really a great thing, so I thought. I also wanted something that wouldn't take up a lot of refrigerator room, and thought this might slide in on top of other items in the fridge.

The item came with the two trays and lids shrink-wrapped together. There are little clamps on the egg portion of the tray that hook to the lid portion. Not well, but they hook. There is NOTHING remotely sturdy about this set. You cannot pick it up by the handle. If you think you can quickly grab an egg and pop the lid back on, think again - it is not quick and you will probably need both hands.

The tray itself holds the eggs very well. Almost too well - the indentations are deep, and we found ourselves using a fork to get the eggs back out. No big deal, but something you should know about these. They would work very well for a buffet table (that is at your home, and you did not have to transport them in these trays anywhere). Some others have said they put ice in the upside down lid and put the tray on the ice. I could see that being helpful in a picnic situation.

Bottom line is that they do not fasten well enough in any way. I would not trust them for transporting eggs. I would not trust lifting them out of the refrigerator. I would not even trust them to keep the eggs fresh, because the seal is not tight on the top/bottom. It basically sits on top of the gg tray, and you use the little latches to pretend to hook the top to the bottom. Meh at best. I would have returned these, but as mentioned, I can see these working well for a buffet or self-serve party situation. That's ALL they would be good for, in my opinion. Just too flimsy for anything else.
I have already purchased a different set via Amazon that is perfect for our needs and airtight too.
So, if you have a lot of home dinner parties or family dinners, this will work on the food table.
If you don't and might want to drive to somewhere and bring your deviled eggs with you, please get a different container.
